label: Message of the day
description: Shown under the server name in the multiplayer list. Colour codes like §a work.

label: Maximum players
description: How many players can be online at once.

label: Difficulty
description: How hard the game is. Players with permission can also change it in game with /difficulty.

label: Game mode
description: The game mode new players start in.

label: Force game mode
description: Put players back in the default game mode every time they join.

label: Hardcore
description: Players are banned (switched to spectator) when they die, and difficulty is locked to hard.

label: Allow flight
description: Don't kick players for flying in survival. Turn on if a mod or plugin lets players fly.

label: Spawn protection radius
description: Blocks around spawn that only operators can change. 0 turns it off.

label: Idle kick (minutes)
description: Kick players who haven't moved for this many minutes. 0 never kicks.

label: Pause when empty (seconds)
description: Stop ticking the world this many seconds after the last player leaves. 0 or less never pauses.

label: World folder
description: The folder the world is stored in. A new name creates a new world on the next start.

label: World seed
description: Seed for generating a new world. Empty picks a random one. Has no effect once the world exists.

label: World type
description: How a new world is generated. Mods can add more types. Has no effect once the world exists.

label: Generator settings
description: JSON options for the world type (for example the layers of a flat world).

label: Generate structures
description: Generate villages, temples and other structures in new chunks.

label: World border radius
description: The largest the world border can be, in blocks from the centre.

label: Initially enabled data packs
description: Comma-separated data packs enabled when a new world is created.

label: Initially disabled data packs
description: Comma-separated data packs that stay off when a new world is created.

label: Region file compression
description: How chunks are compressed on disk. lz4 is faster and larger; none is largest.

label: Whitelist
description: Only players on the whitelist can join. Add them with /whitelist add <name>.

label: Enforce whitelist
description: Kick online players who aren't on the whitelist when it is reloaded.

label: Online mode
description: Check every player's Minecraft account with Mojang. Turning this off lets anyone join with any name; only do it behind a proxy that checks accounts.

label: Require signed chat
description: Only allow players whose chat messages are signed by Mojang.

label: Operator permission level
description: What operators may do: 1 bypass spawn protection, 2 cheat commands, 3 player management, 4 everything.

label: Function permission level
description: The permission level data pack functions run with.

label: Hide online players
description: Don't show who is online in the multiplayer list.

label: Block VPN and proxy connections
description: Kick players whose connection comes from a different address than the one Mojang saw.

label: Log player IP addresses
description: Write the IP address of each joining player to the server log.

label: Accept transfers
description: Let players arrive from another server through the /transfer command.

label: Show a code of conduct
description: Ask players to accept the rules in the server's codeofconduct folder before they join.

label: View distance
description: How many chunks around each player are sent to them. Lower values reduce lag.

label: Simulation distance
description: How many chunks around each player are ticked (mobs, crops, redstone). Lower values reduce lag.

label: Entity visibility range (%)
description: How far away entities are sent to players, as a percentage of the default.

label: Network compression threshold
description: Packets larger than this many bytes are compressed. -1 turns compression off.

label: Watchdog timeout (ms)
description: Stop the server if a single tick takes longer than this. -1 turns the watchdog off.

label: Max chained block updates
description: Limit on consecutive neighbour block updates before the rest are skipped. Negative means no limit.

label: Synchronous chunk writes
description: Wait for chunk saves to reach the disk. Safer after a crash, slower on slow disks.

label: Native network transport
description: Use Linux's faster networking (epoll).

label: Packet rate limit
description: Kick players who send more packets per second than this. 0 means no limit.

label: Chat spam threshold (seconds)
description: The time window for the chat spam check.

label: Command spam threshold (seconds)
description: The time window for the command spam check.

label: Listen address
description: Listen only on this address. Leave empty to accept connections on every address of this machine.

label: Port
description: The port players connect to.

label: Show in server lists
description: Answer status pings, so the server shows as online with its MOTD and player count.

label: Enable query protocol
description: Answer GameSpy4 queries (used by some server-list websites).

label: Query port
description: The UDP port for the query protocol.

label: Status heartbeat interval
description: How often the management protocol reports server status, in seconds. 0 turns it off.

label: Resource pack URL
description: A direct download link to a resource pack (.zip) offered to players when they join.

label: Resource pack SHA-1
description: The pack's SHA-1 checksum, so players re-download it only when it changes.

label: Resource pack ID
description: A UUID identifying the pack on players' computers.

label: Resource pack prompt
description: A message shown when players are asked to download the pack.

label: Require the resource pack
description: Disconnect players who decline the resource pack.

label: Enable RCON
description: Remote console over the network. Inside the sandbox a server may only listen on its own game port, so RCON can't be used yet.

label: RCON port
description: The TCP port for RCON.

label: RCON password
description: The password RCON clients must send.

label: Show RCON commands to operators
description: Tell online operators about commands run over RCON.

label: Show console commands to operators
description: Tell online operators about commands run from the console.

label: Enable the management protocol
description: Minecraft's JSON-RPC server management API. Inside the sandbox a server may only listen on its own game port, so it can't be used yet.

label: Management host
description: The address the management protocol listens on.

label: Management port
description: The port of the management protocol (0 picks any free port).

label: Management secret
description: The token management clients must send. Generated by the server.

label: Management allowed origins
description: Comma-separated web origins allowed to call the management protocol from a browser.

label: Management TLS
description: Encrypt management connections.

label: Management TLS keystore
description: Path to the keystore with the TLS certificate.

label: Management TLS keystore password
description: The keystore's password.

label: JMX monitoring
description: Expose tick-time metrics over Java Management Extensions.

label: Bug report link
description: A link shown to players on the disconnect screen to report problems.

label: Text filtering config
description: Configuration for an external chat filtering service.

label: Text filtering version
description: Which text filtering protocol version the service uses.
